en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large modernist multi‑storey building on a hill surrounded by trees and landscaped grounds. A winding road or driveway with a white fence curves in front of the building. Pine branches frame the view from above. The lower left of the image has the printed word "Pécs" and the lower right "Üdülő szálló". The reverse side shows dense handwritten text, address lines, a Hungarian stamp and postmark, and the printer's mark "FOTO WEINSTOCK".
